verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring work is a fair question for a DevSecOps/CI platform, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a recurring schedule such as cron-style or scheduled pipelines. The closest item (gitlab-docs-59) says flows have triggers that control when they run, and gitlab-docs-58 shows agents triggered from a discussion, issue, or merge request. These are event-driven, one-off triggers, not a recurring schedule, so they earn no credit. The generic CI/CD and REST API automation claims are adjacent and do not show scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
